title: Ensemble Deep-Learning-Based Prognostic and Prediction for Recurrence of Sporadic Odontogenic Keratocysts on Hematoxylin and Eosin Stained Pathological Images of Incisional Biopsies.
summary: Full MDPI text reviewed in Chrome: an ensemble of DenseNet-121, Inception-V3 and Inception-ResNet-V3 classifies recurrence of sporadic odontogenic keratocysts from histology images. The 60-patient cohort supplied about 1,660 annotated images; the 70/15/15 split and held-out results report up to 97% accuracy (abstract also reports ensemble AUC 0.9872). Approve narrowly as a small-cohort image-classification result; possible image-level leakage, no external validation and no prospective utility remain limitations.
ai_technology: learned CNN classifiers (DenseNet-121, Inception-V3, Inception-ResNet-V3) operate on H&E incisional-biopsy images; ensemble operation links histology to recurrence classification.
organization: Department of Oral Pathology and Microbiology

evidence.tested: recurrent/non-recurrent histologic features were distinguished; ensemble reports 97% accuracy, with source abstract reporting AUC 0.9872. Study has only 60 patients and about 1,660 images.
evidence.unknown: Methods/Results: 70/15/15 train/validation/test split within 60 patients; no independent cohort. Image-level partitioning may overstate generalization if images from a patient cross splits; interpret as preliminary.
evidence.ai_role: learned CNN classifiers (DenseNet-121, Inception-V3, Inception-ResNet-V3) operate on H&E incisional-biopsy images; ensemble operation links histology to recurrence classification.
